notes: The prefix 'การ' turns the verb 'สัมภาษณ์' (to interview) into a noun.
When specifically talking about a job interview, you can be more precise by saying 'การสัมภาษณ์งาน' (kān sǎm phâat ngān), where 'งาน' means work or job.

senses.definition: A formal meeting where a person is asked questions to assess their suitability for a job.
